verdict.rationale: Gecko documents source-to-sink call chains and cross-file analysis for vulnerabilities in your own code. The evidence never mentions dependency or SCA alerts, or using reachability to prioritize vulnerable third-party packages. Code-path analysis of first-party findings is an adjacent feature and does not deliver this story, which is a fair question for a security scanner.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can prioritize dependency alerts by whether the vulnerable code is actually reachable from my code
